scope: TheGame production entry at http://localhost:3007/ in the user's Chrome tab
cause: SSGI divided its weighted radiance by the sum of accepted weights. This canceled receiver cosine and range attenuation; a nonzero emitter floor also allowed back-facing transfer. Sparse HDR taps appeared as shifted copies of headlights, roof sign and road markings on unrelated surfaces.
isolation: Observed ghost taxi in the live user tab.
Turned TAA off through the graphics menu: ghost remained.
Rebuilt TheGame browser bundle, not only the Engine dist files.
Temporarily disabled SSR, then planar application, with rebuild/reload/reconnect: ghost headlights remained.
Temporarily disabled SSGI contribution: ghost headlights disappeared.
Restored SSR and planar passes, fixed SSGI quadrature and emitter cosine, rebuilt and reloaded production game.
fix: Use a fixed six-direction integration divisor, preserving both cosines and distance attenuation. Back-facing emitters contribute zero. SSGI remains enabled.

visualVerification.settings: Engine WebGPU, TAA enabled, bloom off, motion blur off, DOF off. Clear-day preset used for final inspection.
visualVerification.observed: No shifted headlights below the taxi bumper in front view; no rectangular roof-sign copies on the roof or duplicated taxi on the ground in elevated side view.
visualVerification.limits: Manual visual verification in a live changing world, not pixel-identical before/after replay or a performance benchmark. Initial crosswalk camera was not reproduced.
